# v0.18.18 Relay capture geometry and response

Relay ON now binds revision 11 and visual-2. The allowed left edge accounts
for asymmetric LDPlayer chrome; this is a new compiled Plan, never a runtime
override of an old pointer guard. An unfinished legacy Relay Plan requires
explicit Stop/Reset and a new batch. Preserve its checkpoint, pending intent,
attempt count and archive evidence; never migrate or clear them to send input.
OFF retains exact revision 9 authority and timing presets remain preferences.

The calibrated closed-card detector accepts bounded one-pixel rasterization
only with all four original green edges, all four continuous yellow edges,
the complete prompt and both Running controls. No timing, artwork, HP estimate
or partial word establishes Relay proof. All input still uses a fresh stable
preflight, durable intent and a separate fresh dispatch witness.

Human Guard runs once per immutable private frame, including expired frames;
each new preflight/dispatch frame is checked independently. ROI freshness uses
the existing exact pixel metrics and thresholds. The 0.5-second witness limit,
Stop/Pause/Human, window/geometry, watchdog mutex and never-replay ledger remain.
Bounded watch counters and one end summary are telemetry only; negative scans
must not add per-frame durable writes or publish old frames as new input proof.

# Axiom Vision v0.18.18 — Relay Response

แก้ Cookie Relay ที่ตรวจพบปุ่มแล้วแต่ไม่ถึงขั้นเตรียมคลิก

นำภาพ Relay ที่ผู้ใช้ให้มาจำลองในกรอบ LDPlayer ตามขนาดใน diagnostic
1642×941 พิกเซล โดยมีแถบบน 41 พิกเซลและแถบเครื่องมือขวา 42 พิกเซล
ตัวตรวจภาพพบปุ่มที่ขอบซ้าย x714 แต่กรอบอนุญาตเดิมเริ่มที่ x722 จึงปฏิเสธ
ก่อนเตรียม intent ปัญหานี้สอดคล้องกับ Log ห้ารอบที่เริ่มเฝ้าแล้วแต่ attempts ยังเป็น 0
ภาพสดในจังหวะที่พลาดไม่ได้อยู่ใน diagnostic จึงยังไม่ใช่การยืนยันพิกเซลของเหตุการณ์จริง

- แก้ขอบซ้ายของกรอบ Relay สำหรับหน้าต่างที่มีแถบเครื่องมือด้านเดียว
  ต้องผ่านข้อความ Relay กรอบสี และ Jump/Slide จากภาพสดตามเดิม
- แก้การอ่านขอบสีที่เหลือหนึ่งพิกเซลหลังย่อภาพ โดยยังตรวจครบทั้งสี่ด้าน
- ตรวจ Human Verification หนึ่งครั้งต่อภาพเดิม รวมภาพที่ช้าจนหมดอายุ
  ภาพใหม่ก่อนส่งคลิกยังต้องตรวจ Human และเงื่อนไข input ทุกครั้ง
- วัดความเปลี่ยนแปลงเฉพาะปุ่มในเส้น Relay ด้วยวิธีและเกณฑ์เดิม
  ลดงานคำนวณภาพพื้นหลังที่กำลังเคลื่อนไหว อายุภาพสูงสุดยัง 0.5 วินาที
- เพิ่มสรุปจำนวนภาพที่ตรวจและเหตุที่ไม่คลิกตอนจบช่วงเฝ้า
  ไม่เขียน Log ทุกภาพลบ และไม่ใช้ข้อมูลสรุปเป็นสิทธิ์ส่ง input

Relay ON ใช้ Mission revision 11 และตัวตรวจภาพ visual-2
Relay OFF ใช้ revision 9 และ Plan เดิม Preset ที่ตั้งชื่อไว้ยังอยู่

ถ้าแบตช์เก่ายังเป็น Relay revision 10 ให้ Stop แล้ว Reset Batch ก่อนเริ่มแบตช์ใหม่
Reset เก็บประวัติเดิมตามระบบ Archive โปรแกรมไม่ล้าง checkpoint หรือ intent ให้อัตโนมัติ
Resume แผนเก่าจะถูกบล็อกพร้อมข้อความให้เริ่มแผนใหม่ เพื่อไม่เปลี่ยนสิทธิ์กลางแบตช์

อัปเดตที่ Settings → CHECK UPDATE รอ worker หยุดและปิด Controller เพื่อติดตั้ง
ถ้า updater ยังรอ active checkpoint ให้ Stop และ Reset Batch ก่อน
ไม่เปลี่ยน Heart Sender, การอ่านสมบัติ, Random Boost หรือกฎ Stop/Pause/Human

การทดสอบใช้ภาพต้นฉบับ การจำลองกรอบหน้าต่าง เวลา และ input พร้อมเส้นตรวจจริง
ยังไม่ได้ยืนยันการกดทันสองวินาทีและการรับคลิกใน Windows/LDPlayer จริง

"""Measure only the already-proved Relay control's fresh-frame pixel delta.

This is a metrics helper, not input authority. The Bridge still owns semantic
proof, Human Guard, region bounds, thresholds, witness age and dispatch guards.
The resize and histogram calculation match the ordinary freshness guard; the
animated full scene is neither converted nor measured on this private path.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import io
from typing import Any


def compare_cookie_relay_freshness(
    reference_png: bytes,
    current_png: bytes,
    region: tuple[int, int, int, int],
    *,
    thumbnail_size: tuple[int, int],
    pixel_delta: int,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return the same ROI metrics used by the existing Bridge thresholds."""
    unavailable = {
        "reason": "frame_comparison_unavailable",
        "dimensions_match": None,
        "region_mean_delta": None,
        "region_changed_ratio": None,
    }
    if (not isinstance(region, tuple) or len(region) != 4
            or any(type(value) is not int for value in region)
            or region[0] < 0 or region[1] < 0 or region[2] <= 0 or region[3] <= 0):
        return {**unavailable, "reason": "target_region_invalid"}
    try:
        from PIL import Image, ImageChops
    except ImportError:
        return unavailable
    try:
        with (Image.open(io.BytesIO(reference_png)) as reference_source,
              Image.open(io.BytesIO(current_png)) as current_source):
            if reference_source.size != current_source.size:
                return {
                    **unavailable,
                    "reason": "image_dimensions_changed",
                    "dimensions_match": False,
                    "reference_size": list(reference_source.size),
                    "current_size": list(current_source.size),
                }
            x, y, width, height = region
            if x + width > reference_source.width or y + height > reference_source.height:
                return {**unavailable, "reason": "target_region_invalid"}
            if reference_png == current_png:
                return {
                    "reason": "identical_bytes",
                    "dimensions_match": True,
                    "region_mean_delta": 0.0,
                    "region_changed_ratio": 0.0,
                }
            reference_source.load()
            current_source.load()
            box = (x, y, x + width, y + height)
            # Cropping before RGB conversion preserves the exact ROI pixels
            # while avoiding two full-scene RGB copies and thumbnail resizes.
            first = reference_source.crop(box).convert("RGB").resize(thumbnail_size)
            second = current_source.crop(box).convert("RGB").resize(thumbnail_size)
            histogram = ImageChops.difference(first, second).convert("L").histogram()
            total = sum(histogram)
            mean_delta = (
                sum(level * count for level, count in enumerate(histogram))
                / (255.0 * total) if total > 0 else 0.0
            )
            changed_ratio = sum(histogram[pixel_delta + 1:]) / total if total > 0 else 0.0
            return {
                "reason": "target_region_measured",
                "dimensions_match": True,
                "region_mean_delta": round(mean_delta, 6),
                "region_changed_ratio": round(changed_ratio, 6),
            }
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, Image.DecompressionBombError):
        return unavailable

"""Relay frame evidence across real emulator-chrome raster phases."""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import visionstudio_cookie_relay as relay
from test_cookie_relay_vision import png, relay_frame


class CookieRelayCaptureVariantTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @staticmethod
    def emulator_frame(top: int, left: int = 0) -> Image.Image:
        image = Image.new("RGB", (1642, 941), (30, 32, 38))
        game = relay_frame().resize((1600, 900), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        image.paste(game, (left, top))
        return image

    def test_right_toolbar_and_each_native_top_chrome_raster_phase(self):
        # LDPlayer captures include its right toolbar and top bar. Symmetric
        # padding exercises a different resampling phase and missed this case.
        for top in range(42):
            with self.subTest(top=top):
                proof = relay.detect_cookie_relay(png(self.emulator_frame(top)))
                self.assertIsNotNone(proof)
                self.assertAlmostEqual(proof.center[0], 816, delta=5)
                self.assertAlmostEqual(proof.center[1], 430 + top, delta=5)

    def test_raster_fallback_keeps_both_closed_frame_colors(self):
        yellow_edges = ((365, 166, 451, 169), (365, 261, 451, 264),
                        (358, 174, 361, 255), (455, 174, 458, 255))
        green_edges = ((366, 172, 451, 175), (366, 256, 451, 259),
                       (364, 177, 367, 254), (449, 177, 452, 254))
        for color, edges in (("yellow", yellow_edges), ("green", green_edges)):
            for index, box in enumerate(edges):
                with self.subTest(color=color, edge=index):
                    game = relay_frame()
                    ImageDraw.Draw(game).rectangle(box, fill=(75, 95, 65))
                    image = Image.new("RGB", (1642, 941), (30, 32, 38))
                    image.paste(game.resize((1600, 900), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS), (0, 40))
                    self.assertIsNone(relay.detect_cookie_relay(png(image)))

    def test_full_prompt_and_both_running_controls_are_still_required(self):
        boxes = {
            "relay_word": (455, 140, 505, 160),
            "prompt": (239, 136, 574, 161),
            "jump": (65, 374, 144, 405),
            "slide": (661, 374, 735, 405),
            "human_overlay": (285, 130, 520, 325),
        }
        for name, box in boxes.items():
            with self.subTest(missing=name):
                game = relay_frame()
                ImageDraw.Draw(game).rectangle(box, fill=(75, 95, 65))
                image = Image.new("RGB", (1642, 941), (30, 32, 38))
                image.paste(game.resize((1600, 900), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS), (0, 40))
                self.assertIsNone(relay.detect_cookie_relay(png(image)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Equivalence and rejection tests for Relay's ROI-only freshness metrics."""
from __future__ import annotations

import io
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import visionstudio_bridge as bridge
from visionstudio_cookie_relay_freshness import compare_cookie_relay_freshness


def png(image: Image.Image, *, compression: int = 1) -> bytes:
    output = io.BytesIO()
    image.save(output, format="PNG", compress_level=compression)
    return output.getvalue()


class CookieRelayFreshnessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    region = (550, 250, 180, 180)

    def compare(self, before: bytes, after: bytes, region=None) -> dict:
        return compare_cookie_relay_freshness(
            before, after, self.region if region is None else region,
            thumbnail_size=bridge.FRESHNESS_THUMBNAIL_SIZE,
            pixel_delta=bridge.FRESHNESS_PIXEL_DELTA,
        )

    def assert_roi_equal(self, before: bytes, after: bytes) -> dict:
        ordinary = bridge.compare_frame_freshness(before, after, self.region)
        private = self.compare(before, after)
        for key in ("dimensions_match", "region_mean_delta", "region_changed_ratio"):
            self.assertEqual(private[key], ordinary[key], key)
        return private

    def frame(self, background: tuple[int, int, int]) -> Image.Image:
        image = Image.new("RGB", (1280, 720), background)
        ImageDraw.Draw(image).rectangle((550, 250, 729, 429), fill=(120, 185, 60))
        return image

    def test_animated_background_does_not_change_identical_control_metrics(self):
        before, after = png(self.frame((20, 30, 40))), png(self.frame((230, 200, 160)))
        ordinary = bridge.compare_frame_freshness(before, after, self.region)
        self.assertFalse(ordinary["passed"])
        private = self.assert_roi_equal(before, after)
        self.assertEqual(private["region_mean_delta"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(private["region_changed_ratio"], 0)

    def test_control_change_retains_existing_rejection_metrics(self):
        first = self.frame((20, 30, 40))
        second = first.copy()
        ImageDraw.Draw(second).rectangle((550, 250, 729, 429), fill=(250, 250, 250))
        private = self.assert_roi_equal(png(first), png(second))
        self.assertGreater(private["region_mean_delta"], bridge.FRESHNESS_REGION_MEAN_DELTA_LIMIT)
        self.assertGreater(private["region_changed_ratio"], bridge.FRESHNESS_REGION_CHANGED_RATIO_LIMIT)

    def test_partial_tone_changes_and_source_modes_have_exact_roi_equivalence(self):
        first = self.frame((15, 80, 125))
        second = first.copy()
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(second)
        for offset in range(0, 180, 9):
            draw.line((550, 250 + offset, 729, 250 + offset), fill=(150, 202, 90), width=3)
        for mode in ("RGB", "RGBA", "L", "P"):
            with self.subTest(mode=mode):
                self.assert_roi_equal(png(first.convert(mode)), png(second.convert(mode)))

    def test_identical_bytes_and_different_png_encodings_keep_zero_delta(self):
        image = self.frame((15, 80, 125))
        data = png(image)
        self.assert_roi_equal(data, data)
        self.assert_roi_equal(data, png(image, compression=6))

    def test_dimension_change_and_invalid_png_cannot_prove_freshness(self):
        data = png(self.frame((15, 80, 125)))
        other_size = png(Image.new("RGB", (1281, 720), (15, 80, 125)))
        result = self.compare(data, other_size)
        self.assertIs(result["dimensions_match"], False)
        self.assertIsNone(result["region_mean_delta"])
        for invalid in (b"not a PNG", b"", data[:50]):
            with self.subTest(invalid=invalid[:10]):
                result = self.compare(data, invalid)
                self.assertIsNone(result["dimensions_match"])
                self.assertIsNone(result["region_mean_delta"])
        self.assertIsNone(self.compare(b"not a PNG", b"not a PNG")["dimensions_match"])

    def test_invalid_region_is_rejected_before_any_control_comparison(self):
        image = self.frame((15, 80, 125))
        data, reencoded = png(image), png(image, compression=6)
        for region in ((-1, 0, 10, 10), (0, 0, 0, 10), (1200, 0, 100, 10),
                       (0, 0, True, 10), (0, 0, 10), (0.0, 0, 10, 10)):
            with self.subTest(region=region):
                result = self.compare(data, reencoded, region)
                self.assertIsNone(result["dimensions_match"])
                self.assertEqual(result["reason"], "target_region_invalid")
                self.assertIsNone(self.compare(data, data, region)["dimensions_match"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Real visual/Controller/ledger Relay path with a modeled loaded capture clock.

Windows capture and input are adapters; recognition, Human Guard, frozen Plan
checks and durable intent/commit I/O are the actual production implementations.
The fake monotonic clock gives phase costs rather than asserting host speed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from unittest import mock

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

import test_cookie_relay_runtime as runtime
from test_cookie_relay_vision import relay_frame

bridge = runtime.bridge


def png(image):
    output = io.BytesIO()
    image.save(output, "PNG", compress_level=1)
    return output.getvalue()


class Clock:
    def __init__(self):
        self.now = 1000.0

    def advance(self, seconds):
        self.now += seconds


class ClockEvent:
    def __init__(self, clock):
        self.clock = clock
        self.stopped = False

    def is_set(self):
        return self.stopped

    def set(self):
        self.stopped = True

    def wait(self, seconds):
        self.clock.advance(max(0.0, seconds))
        return self.stopped


class CookieRelayHotPathTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def real_fixture(self, root, *, size=(1600, 900), image=None):
        server, session, desktop, old_window, _, _, state = runtime.CookieRelayRuntimeTests.fixture(self, root)
        window = runtime.test_bridge.VisionStudioBridgeTests().make_window(
            executable="dnplayer.exe", title="Cookie Run", left=40, top=30,
            width=size[0], height=size[1],
        )
        image = image or png(relay_frame().resize(size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))
        desktop.window = window
        desktop.capture_png = lambda _window: image
        session.last_window, session.last_image = window, image
        session.fixed_geometry_bounds = (40, 30, *size)
        session.loop_recovery_context["loop_start_fixed_geometry_bounds"] = list(session.fixed_geometry_bounds)
        state["fixed_geometry"]["bounds"] = list(session.fixed_geometry_bounds)
        state["universal_plan"]["revision"] = bridge.universal_mission_module.UNIVERSAL_RELAY_MISSION_REVISION

        # This isolates the duplicated initial Human check. Positive captures
        # are byte-identical, so freshness has its real zero-work shortcut.
        # Animated source-image phase tests separately charge ROI/window work.
        clock = Clock()
        with mock.patch.object(bridge.time, "monotonic", side_effect=lambda: clock.now), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            server, session, desktop, window, relay = self.real_fixture(Path(tmp))
            negative = png(Image.new("RGB", (1600, 900), (75, 95, 65)))
            starts, ends = 1000.3, 1002.3
            captures = []
            clicks = []
            stop = ClockEvent(clock)
            session.running_monitor_stop = stop
            session.running_monitor_focus_seconds = 0
            session.running_monitor_started_monotonic = clock.now
            session.running_monitor_interval_seconds = 3
            session.running_monitor_timeout_seconds = 4
            session.running_monitor_thread = threading.current_thread()
            original_capture = server._capture_reliable_png
            original_human = server._cookie_relay_human_guard
            original_detect = server._detect_cookie_relay
            original_gate = server._controller_gate
            original_write = session.write_checkpoint
            native_click = desktop.click

            def capture(_window):
                # Diagnostic capture mean is 167–175ms including PNG health.
                # This cost is modeled once; the actual PNG/health path runs.
                selected = relay if starts <= clock.now < ends else negative
                clock.advance(.175)
                captures.append(clock.now)
                desktop.capture_png = lambda __: selected
                return original_capture(_window)

            def human(*args):
                result = original_human(*args)
                clock.advance(.09)  # Loaded Human cost, twice measured Linux44ms.
                return result

            def detect(raw):
                result = original_detect(raw)
                clock.advance(.15)  # Loaded cost near measured137ms maximum.
                return result

            def gate(_session):
                result = original_gate(_session)
                clock.advance(.005)
                return result

            def write(*args, **kwargs):
                result = original_write(*args, **kwargs)
                clock.advance(.03)  # Real fsync executes; model Windows flush cost.
                return result

            def click(*args):
                clicks.append(clock.now)
                result = native_click(*args)
                stop.set()
                return result

            server._capture_reliable_png = capture
            server._cookie_relay_human_guard = human
            server._detect_cookie_relay = detect
            server._controller_gate = gate
            session.write_checkpoint = write
            desktop.click = click
            before = copy.deepcopy((session.stage_action_attempts, session.completed_stage_ids,
                                    session.committed_stage_ids, session.last_action_transition))
            server._running_monitor_worker(session, stop)
            self.assertEqual(len(clicks), 1, session.running_monitor_error)
            self.assertLess(clicks[0], ends)
            self.assertGreaterEqual(clicks[0], starts)
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["status"], "committed")
            self.assertEqual(before, (session.stage_action_attempts, session.completed_stage_ids,
                                      session.committed_stage_ids, session.last_action_transition))
            ledger = json.loads(session.checkpoint_path.read_bytes())["cookie_relay_state"]
            self.assertEqual((ledger["status"], ledger["attempts"]), ("committed", 1))

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import visionstudio_controller as ui
import visionstudio_controller_state as controller
import visionstudio_universal_mission as universal


class Variable:
    def __init__(self, value=None): self.value = value
    def get(self): return self.value
    def set(self, value): self.value = value


class HeadlessController(ui.VisionStudioController):
    @property
    def control_path(self): return self.test_control_path
    @property
    def data_root(self): return self.test_data_root


class CookieRelayPlanUpgradeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.path = Path(self.temporary.name) / "controller/state.json"
        self.checkpoint_path = (Path(self.temporary.name) / "checkpoints"
                                / f"{ui.runtime_mission_name(universal.UNIVERSAL_MISSION_IDENTITY_PATH)}-active.json")
        self.checkpoint_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.config = {
            "run_profile": {"mode": "custom", "expected_seconds": 120},
            "cookie_relay": {"enabled": True},
        }
        state = controller.request_start(
            self.path, mission_path=universal.UNIVERSAL_MISSION_IDENTITY_PATH,
            requested_loops=None, run_until=None, telegram_enabled=True,
            universal_config=self.config,
        )
        self.config = copy.deepcopy(state["universal_config"])
        state["desired_state"] = "stopped"
        state["worker"].update(status="stopped", pid=None)
        state["universal_plan"].update(revision="10", sha256="a" * 64)
        state["batch_plan"]["universal_plan"] = copy.deepcopy(state["universal_plan"])
        controller.write_state(self.path, state)
        self.checkpoint = {
            "status": "blocked", "mission_source": "universal-code",
            "mission_contract_sha256": "a" * 64,
            "universal_config": copy.deepcopy(self.config),
            "current_stage_id": "passive-running", "current_stage_phase": "entered",
            "pending_action_intent": {"id": "preserve-purchase", "replay_policy": "never"},
            "cookie_relay_state": {
                "status": "pending", "attempts": 1, "intent_id": "preserve-relay",
                "mission_sha256": "a" * 64,
            },
        }
        self.checkpoint_path.write_text(json.dumps(self.checkpoint) + "\n")
        self.app = self.make_app()

    def make_app(self):
        app = object.__new__(HeadlessController)
        app.test_control_path = self.path
        app.test_data_root = Path(self.temporary.name)
        app.mission_var = Variable(str(universal.UNIVERSAL_MISSION_IDENTITY_PATH))
        app._stats = lambda: ({}, json.loads(self.checkpoint_path.read_text()))
        app._validate_ready = lambda: universal.compile_universal_mission(self.config).mission
        app._requested_loops = lambda: None
        app._universal_config = lambda: copy.deepcopy(self.config)
        app._run_profile = lambda: copy.deepcopy(self.config["run_profile"])
        app._boost_config = lambda: {"random_mode": "targeted", "random_target": "Double Coins"}
        app.telegram_enabled = Variable(True)
        app.geometry_status = Variable()
        app.geometry_text = Variable()
        app._heart_conflict_for_universal = lambda: None
        app._worker_active = lambda: False
        app._heart_worker_active = lambda: False
        app._launch_worker = mock.Mock()
        app._archive_runtime_batch = mock.Mock()
        app._retire_open_review_verification = mock.Mock()
        app._remember_operator_resume = mock.Mock()
        app._latest_frame_path = lambda: None
        app._add_activity = mock.Mock()
        return app

    def assert_preserved(self, state_bytes, checkpoint_bytes):
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), state_bytes)
        self.assertEqual(self.checkpoint_path.read_bytes(), checkpoint_bytes)
        self.app._launch_worker.assert_not_called()
        self.app._archive_runtime_batch.assert_not_called()

    def test_old_blocked_relay_start_cannot_overwrite_even_with_archive_flag(self):
        for archive in (False, True):
            with self.subTest(archive=archive):
                before, checkpoint = self.path.read_bytes(), self.checkpoint_path.read_bytes()
                result = self.app._execute_start_run(
                    archive_resumable_checkpoint=archive,
                    verified_geometry={"bounds": [10, 20, 1642, 941], "source": "test"},
                )
                self.assertFalse(result.ok, "An old Relay checkpoint must not be replaced by Start")
                self.assertEqual(result.code, "relay_plan_upgrade_required")
                self.assertIn("Reset Batch", result.detail)
                self.assert_preserved(before, checkpoint)

    def test_old_relay_resume_preserves_pending_clicks_without_launch(self):
        for remote in (False, True):
            with self.subTest(remote=remote):
                before, checkpoint = self.path.read_bytes(), self.checkpoint_path.read_bytes()
                result = self.app._execute_resume_run(remote_request=remote)
                self.assertFalse(result.ok)
                self.assertEqual(result.code, "relay_plan_upgrade_required")
                self.assert_preserved(before, checkpoint)

    def test_gate_is_read_only_and_recognizes_active_stopped_or_blocked_old_authority(self):
        state = controller.read_state(self.path)
        before = copy.deepcopy(state), copy.deepcopy(self.checkpoint)
        for status in ("active", "stopped", "blocked"):
            checkpoint = {**self.checkpoint, "status": status}
            self.assertTrue(ui.relay_plan_upgrade_required(state, checkpoint))
        self.assertEqual((state, self.checkpoint), before)

    def test_off_current_completed_and_reset_authority_need_no_upgrade_gate(self):
        state = controller.read_state(self.path)
        current = copy.deepcopy(state)
        config, plan = controller.compile_universal_plan(self.config)
        current["universal_plan"] = plan
        current["batch_plan"].update(universal_config=config, universal_plan=plan)
        checkpoint = {**self.checkpoint, "mission_contract_sha256": plan["sha256"]}
        self.assertFalse(ui.relay_plan_upgrade_required(current, checkpoint))
        off = copy.deepcopy(state)
        config, plan = controller.compile_universal_plan({"run_profile": {"mode": "short"}})
        off["batch_plan"].update(universal_config=config, universal_plan=plan)
        checkpoint = {**self.checkpoint, "universal_config": config, "mission_contract_sha256": plan["sha256"]}
        self.assertEqual(plan["revision"], "9")
        self.assertFalse(ui.relay_plan_upgrade_required(off, checkpoint))
        completed = copy.deepcopy(state)
        completed["batch_plan"]["status"] = "completed"
        self.assertFalse(ui.relay_plan_upgrade_required(completed, self.checkpoint))
        for status in ("reset", "archived", "completed"):
            self.assertFalse(ui.relay_plan_upgrade_required(state, {"status": status}))

    def test_old_gate_requires_the_same_frozen_checkpoint_and_plan(self):
        state = controller.read_state(self.path)
        for patch in (
            {"mission_source": "other"},
            {"mission_contract_sha256": "b" * 64},
            {"universal_config": {}},
        ):
            self.assertFalse(ui.relay_plan_upgrade_required(state, {**self.checkpoint, **patch}))

    def test_automatic_launch_and_continuation_preserve_all_authority(self):
        before, checkpoint = self.path.read_bytes(), self.checkpoint_path.read_bytes()
        with mock.patch.object(ui.subprocess, "Popen") as popen:
            ui.VisionStudioController._launch_worker(self.app, resume=True, worker_mode="local")
            self.app.worker_continuation_queue = queue.Queue()
            self.app.worker_continuation_queue.put((True, None))
            self.app.next_worker_mode = "local"
            self.app._drain_worker_continuations()
            self.app._begin_stalled_auto_recovery(controller.read_state(self.path))
        popen.assert_not_called()
        self.assertIsNone(self.app.next_worker_mode)
        self.assert_preserved(before, checkpoint)

    def test_blocked_registration_does_not_create_phantom_old_plan_recovery(self):
        state = controller.patch_state(self.path, desired_state="blocked", worker={"status": "blocked", "pid": None})
        self.app.worker_continuation_queue = queue.Queue()
        self.app._enqueue_worker_ui_log = mock.Mock()
        before, checkpoint = self.path.read_bytes(), self.checkpoint_path.read_bytes()
        registered = self.app._register_blocked_review(state, {}, self.checkpoint)
        self.assertEqual(registered["desired_state"], "blocked")
        self.assertFalse(registered["worker"].get("recovery_next_at"))
        self.assertTrue(self.app.worker_continuation_queue.empty())
        self.app._enqueue_worker_ui_log.assert_not_called()
        self.assert_preserved(before, checkpoint)

    def test_telegram_disables_run_resume_but_keeps_stop_reset_and_reads(self):
        before, checkpoint = self.path.read_bytes(), self.checkpoint_path.read_bytes()
        snapshot = self.app.telegram_control_snapshot()
        self.assertFalse(snapshot["actions"]["run"])
        self.assertFalse(snapshot["actions"]["resume"])
        self.assertTrue(snapshot["actions"]["reset"])
        for action in ("status", "summary", "log"):
            self.assertTrue(snapshot["actions"][action])
        self.assertIn("Reset Batch", snapshot["controller"]["last_event"])
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["binding"]["universal_plan"]["revision"], "10")
        self.assertTrue(snapshot["binding"]["relay_plan_upgrade_required"])
        self.assert_preserved(before, checkpoint)

    def test_old_checkpoint_keeps_heart_exclusion_and_reset_guidance(self):
        self.assertIn("Reset Batch", self.app._universal_conflict_for_heart())
        state = controller.read_state(self.path)
        status, detail = ui.blocked_recovery_status(state, self.checkpoint)
        self.assertEqual(status, "RESET REQUIRED")
        self.assertIn("Reset Batch", detail)
        state["desired_state"] = "human_verification"
        status, _detail = ui.blocked_recovery_status(state, self.checkpoint)
        self.assertEqual(status, "HUMAN CHECK")

    def test_explicit_reset_archives_exact_pending_checkpoint_then_allows_new_plan(self):
        saved = controller.save_run_profile_preset(self.path, name="ฟาร์ม EXP", expected_seconds=120)
        original = self.checkpoint_path.read_bytes()
        self.app.worker_generation = 1
        self.app.refresh = mock.Mock()
        self.app._archive_runtime_batch = lambda: ui.VisionStudioController._archive_runtime_batch(self.app)
        result = self.app._execute_reset_batch()
        self.assertTrue(result.ok, result.detail)
        archives = list((Path(self.temporary.name) / "controller/archive").glob("*-checkpoint-*.json"))
        self.assertEqual(len(archives), 1)
        self.assertEqual(archives[0].read_bytes(), original)
        tombstone = json.loads(self.checkpoint_path.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(tombstone["status"], "reset")
        self.assertIsNone(tombstone.get("pending_action_intent"))
        reset = controller.read_state(self.path)
        self.assertEqual(reset["run_profile_presets"], saved["run_profile_presets"])
        self.assertIsNone(reset["batch_plan"])
        result = self.app._execute_start_run(
            archive_resumable_checkpoint=False,
            verified_geometry={"bounds": [10, 20, 1642, 941], "source": "test"},
        )
        self.assertTrue(result.ok, result.detail)
        fresh = controller.read_state(self.path)
        self.assertEqual(fresh["batch_plan"]["universal_plan"]["revision"], "11")
        self.assertEqual(archives[0].read_bytes(), original)
        self.app._launch_worker.assert_called_once_with(resume=False)
